notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for fan-out of one queued timestamped interaction to multiple recipients after the producing federate resigns. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the C++ standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies independent recipient subscription, time-advance and next-message request servicing, retention of the queued interaction after source resignation, the standard post-resignation retraction boundary, and exactly one per-recipient callback with preserved timestamp, payload, tag, producer, order, transport, and retraction metadata before each recipient's grant. No DDM, provider-specific name, registry, header, or implementation behavior is part of this contract.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped interaction, resignation, retraction, time-advance, and next-message request services with FederateAmbassador timestamped receive and grant callbacks
